description:
Restore PLV.Engine-compatible structural wire-diffing. Currently the LiveView shim assigns _filament_rendered = {:safe, iodata}, so every re-render sends the full HTML blob over the WebSocket — meaningful wire-size regression vs the legacy ~F path which produced %Phoenix.LiveView.Rendered{} with proper static/dynamic split.

Solution: Filament.Web.to_rendered(walked_vnode) walks the tree and emits a %Rendered{} with:
- static: list of HTML chunks between dynamic positions
- dynamic: closure returning the runtime values for dynamic positions
- fingerprint: stable structural hash (so PLV recognizes 'same template, different values')
- Phoenix.LiveView.Comprehension structs nested for :for results

Filament.LiveView.to_safe(walked) becomes Filament.Web.to_rendered(walked); EEx <%= @_filament_rendered %> embeds the Rendered directly. PLV's diff engine walks it normally.

## Files
- lib/filament/web.ex (new to_rendered/1)
- lib/filament/live_view.ex (swap to_safe → to_rendered at all assign sites)

## TDD
1. Test: walked vnode tree round-trips through to_rendered and Phoenix.HTML.Safe to produce identical HTML to to_iodata.
2. Test: stable fingerprint for two renders of the same component shape.
3. Test: dynamic positions update without changing static parts (PLV diff correctness).
4. Test: :for results produce a Comprehension struct.

## Acceptance
- Wire-size: identical content across renders sends NO message; partial change sends only changed dynamic slot(s).
- Chrome validation across all four examples still works.
- 380+ tests green.
title: Phase 1.5.2: Web converter emits %Rendered{} with structural diffing
